Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.config

Class PromptLoaderService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.config.PromptLoaderService
@Service public class PromptLoaderService extends Object
Filesystem-first, classpath-fallback loader for prompt template files.

When aihealthcare.prompts.directory is set to a non-blank path, this service checks that directory for the requested template file before falling back to the packaged /prompts/ directory on the classpath. This allows prompt text to be edited with any text editor at runtime — without recompiling or redeploying the application.

Resolution order:

  1. If aihealthcare.prompts.directory is set and the file exists there, return its contents.
  2. Otherwise load /prompts/{templateName} from the classpath.

Typical YAML configuration: 


 aihealthcare:
   prompts:
     directory: prompts/   # relative or absolute path; empty = classpath only

      public PromptLoaderService(@Value("${aihealthcare.prompts.directory:}") String promptsDirectory)
      Constructs the service with the configured external prompts directory.
      Parameters:
      promptsDirectory - Path to an external directory containing prompt template files. An empty string disables filesystem resolution and falls back to classpath.

      public String load(String templateName)
      Loads a prompt template by filename, checking the external directory first and falling back to the classpath.
      Parameters:
      templateName - Filename within the prompts directory (e.g. "summarize-articles.txt"). Must not be blank.
      Returns:
      The template content as a UTF-8 string.
